manifest_row.title: Judge: Michigan agency can evaluate Great Lakes tunnel plan

screening.main_topic: A ruling on the Michigan Public Service Commission’s authority to review Enbridge’s proposed oil pipeline tunnel.
screening.climate_relevance: The ruling bars the commission from weighing the pipeline’s contribution to climate change, while environmental advocates argue that the long-term oil tunnel would worsen climate impacts.
screening.reason: The article primarily concerns regulatory authority and pipeline safety, but climate change is a meaningful part of the dispute and the environmental groups’ response.
